model: InRow ACRD60x / ACRC60x cooling units (Modbus register map 990-5786)
applies_to: APC / Schneider Electric InRow ACRD60x and ACRC60x in-row cooling units, register map part number 990-5786A.
summary: The InRow ACRD60x and ACRC60x are in-row cooling units for data-centre rows and contained aisles. Their controller answers Modbus RTU and Modbus TCP with everything in holding registers. This map covers the cooling-group values (output, demand, setpoints, airflow), the unit's operating mode, supply/return/rack-inlet temperatures, humidity, fan speed, chilled-water and refrigerant readings, compressor VFD data, run hours, service settings, thresholds and 80-plus alarm flags.

addressing.note: The map prints three columns: the Modicon number (40001 style), the absolute register in hex and the absolute register in decimal. The notes state that absolute register 0 is Modicon 40001 and is address zero on the wire, so the decimal column is the wire address (e.g. 41226 = wire 1225).

source.title: Modbus Register Map: InRow ACRD60x / ACRC60x
source.pages: pp. 1-8 (notes p. 1; Group Data pp. 1-2, Unit Data pp. 2-5, Alarms pp. 6-7, Modbus counters p. 8)

notes: The map gives every block twice: a US-units copy (deg F, CFM, ft; Group Data at 0-72, Unit Data at 128-352) and a metric copy 1000 registers higher (deg C, L/s, m). Only the metric copy, the alarm block (512-598) and the Modbus counters are listed here; for US units subtract 1000 from the address.

Per the map: 32-bit values (UINT32, INT32) are big-endian, most-significant word first; signed values and ENUMs are two's complement 16-bit; strings carry two characters per register, high byte first.
Reads use function code 3 or 4; writes use function code 16, or 6 for single-register points.

Reading a single reserved/undefined register returns an exception; a block read that starts on a valid register returns zeros for undefined ones. Reserved rows and the raw VFD alarm/warning status streams (1278, 1280) are left out.
The map prints no date; 2017-03 is the PDF's own creation date (2017-03-08).

integration.summary: Read the unit operating mode (1206, ENUM) and the supply/return air temperatures (1225, 1227), rack inlet temperatures (1238-1243) and fan speed (1235), which are UINT32 values in tenths, high word first. Write the group cool setpoint at 1023 (tenths of deg C, two registers with function 16).

minimum_registers.why: First alarm flag (alarm block starts here)

integration.enable: Not described in the register map.
quirks: The decimal 'Absolute Starting Register Number' is the wire address; the Modicon column is that number plus 40001.
Every UINT32/INT32 takes two registers, most-significant word first; write them with function code 16.
Temperatures such as supply and rack-inlet are listed as UINT32 even though they are in tenths of deg C.
setup: Both Modbus RTU (serial) and Modbus TCP are supported per the map; the serial settings and unit ID are not listed in this document.
gotchas: A single large read can take 2 s or more; if requests time out, read fewer registers at a time or raise the timeout.
Reading before the controller has data ready returns an invalid-address error.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
